summary: Cybin Inc. (Helus Pharma) filed a Form 6-K announcing CEO Michael Cola stepped down immediately at the board's request. Co-founder and Executive Chairman Eric So resumes as Interim CEO while a successor search begins. No financial terms, premium, or deal structure are involved. This is a forced leadership transition, not a routine circular; the board initiated the change. Watch for the permanent CEO appointment and the APPROACH trial data readout (HLP003) expected in Q4 2026, which may impact stock direction.
